brand.name: Asociación Armonía
brand.tagline: Bird and biodiversity conservation in Bolivia

hero.title: Conserving Bolivia's biodiversity
hero.text: We research, protect and restore the habitats of Bolivia's threatened birds, working hand in hand with local communities, partners and allies.

about.title: A Bolivian organization devoted to birds and their habitats
about.text: For three decades, Armonía has combined science, reserve management and community work to protect threatened species and the landscapes they depend on.

cards.text: Funders, strategic allies and corporate members.

landscapes.title: Five landscapes, one mission
landscapes.text: Our work is organized across Bolivia's great landscapes. Each one has its own species, challenges and communities.

beni.name: Beni Grasslands
beni.text: Seasonally flooded savannas and wetlands, home to the Blue-throated Macaw and migratory birds.

yungas.name: Yungas
yungas.text: Montane cloud forests with outstanding diversity and endemic species.

andes.name: High Andes
andes.text: Mountains, high wetlands and native forests that sustain water and life.

seco.name: Inter-Andean Dry Forest
seco.text: Dry valleys and canyons where the Red-fronted Macaw, endemic to Bolivia, nests.

amazonia.name: Amazon
amazonia.text: Tropical forests and rivers of northern Bolivia, refuge of the Masked Antpitta.

programs.title: Conservation programs
programs.text: Long-term initiatives for priority species and their habitats.

barbaazul.name: Blue-throated Macaw Program
barbaazul.text: Reserves, nest boxes and monitoring for one of the world's most threatened birds.

palkachupa.name: Palkachupa Program
palkachupa.text: Community conservation in Apolo with indigenous peoples and producers.

tunari.name: Tunari Program
tunari.text: Restoration, water and fire prevention in Tunari National Park.

frenteroja.name: Red-fronted Macaw Program
frenteroja.text: Species action plan across four dry forest river basins.

tororoi.name: Masked Antpitta Program
tororoi.text: Censuses and municipal protected areas in the Bolivian Amazon.

conservaaves.name: Conserva Aves
conservaaves.text: Regional initiative strengthening key biodiversity areas.

accionandina.name: Acción Andina
accionandina.text: A movement to restore high Andean forests with communities.
